title: 8-Mode Ring First-Convergence & Hold Phase (Legacy Prior Cohort)
intuition: Historical pre-refactor comparison cohort of `ring_hold` retained under its original prior ownership contract so legacy baselines stay strictly separated from `recipe_owned_v1` tasks. Monitors dense first-convergence and sustained hold on an 8-mode 2D Gaussian ring (modes == 8, hq >= 0.90) using the archived K3P ConvergenceGate, producing the exact state extended by `ring_extension`.
failure_mode: Recipes that briefly hit 8/8 modes and then drift below hq=0.90 or drop a mode fail to lock in a valid hold state.
protocol_notes: Retained legacy diagnostic cohort for `ring_hold` before the recipe-owned prior refactor; cannot substitute for current ordinary qualification cells.
